title: node-lesson-saved
description: A row's lesson saved in its node file in the working copy, as the node's next revision; a file changed since it was opened, stopped; or why not.

conflict.description: The file changed since it was opened: nothing is saved.

revision.description: The revision saved; on a conflict, the revision the file now is.

opened.description: The SHA-256 of the file as it now is.

findings.description: What the node's checks found that it still lacks.

writer.description: On a conflict, who wrote the file as it now is.

theirs.description: On a conflict, the file as it now is, as base64.
